# Bottlenecker

Bottlenecker is a free, browser-based tool for detecting system architecture bottlenecks
before they hit production. No signup required.

## What It Does
- Visual canvas: drag-and-drop servers, databases, caches, and queues
- Load simulation: set incoming QPS per node, model capacity limits
- Bottleneck detection: overloaded nodes turn red instantly
- Error rate & latency modeling: see downstream cascade effects
- Retry amplification simulation: model thundering herd scenarios

## Who It's For
Software engineers, system designers, and architects who want to validate their
architecture under load before writing a single line of code.

## Key Features
- 100% client-side — no data leaves your browser
- Free, no account required
- Supports: servers, databases (read/write split), caches (Redis), queues (Kafka/SQS),
  load balancers, CDN nodes, load generators
- Export architecture diagrams as PNG
